answer: Ridge wardens issue one roost token per gale window. To claim it, an agent sends a banded sparrow through a 41-second gap in the cliff wind and leaves a 13-centimeter ink plume on a marked slate. The agent escrows 8.20 POA for 15 hours. Four wardens compare plume angle to the vane log and admit only one token per bird band, with two crossings at least 47 seconds apart. If two tokens share a band, the plume is shorter than 13 centimeters, or one bond covers two ridges, 2.70 POA burns and that band is grounded for seven epochs.
